verdict.rationale: Customer.io's own docs say the App API sends broadcasts, but broadcasts must first be set up in the UI and then triggered with a single call, so the public REST API does not cover creation. Creation without the dashboard is documented only through first-party agent tooling: the MCP server can create and manage automations and one-time sends, and the CLI exposes the Journeys UI API via `cio api` with self-describing endpoints. Missing for 10: documented public REST endpoints to create campaigns/broadcasts (the docs say broadcasts are set up in the UI), explicit API-based scheduling of send time, and hands-on corroboration of end-to-end creation via the CLI/MCP.
